chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about reciting poetry: does it invalidate wudu (ablution)? He said: No.

key_terms.الْوُضُوءَ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification for salat
key_terms.لَا: a direct negation indicating that it does not

ai.seo_question: Does reciting poetry invalidate wudu (ablution) in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that reciting poetry does not invalidate wudu (ablution). It relates to ritual purity and clarifies that such speech is not among the acts that nullify wudu.
